title: Razorpay pricing - 1%-3% + GST per transaction, no setup or annual fees
clean_text: Razorpay charges no setup fee and no annual maintenance charge; merchants pay only when a transaction succeeds. Most domestic payment methods (credit/debit cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets) are priced at 2% + 18% GST. Premium methods (EMI, corporate cards, Amex/Diners, Pay Later) run about 3% + GST, as do international card payments, while international bank transfers cost 1% + GST. A flat 0.99% per-transaction subscription fee applies for automated billing/retry logic. UPI transactions get tiered discounts once cumulative sales cross set thresholds (Rs. 25 lakh, then Rs. 5 crore). Domestic payments settle in T+2 business days; international payments settle in T+7.
